plan.title: bug(skills): the design-critique router conveys its prohibitions but not its structure, and its EXIT line invites self-dispatch

narratives.Description: bug(skills): the design-critique router conveys its prohibitions but not its structure, and its EXIT line invites self-dispatch
narratives.Overview:
> **Recut 2026-08-28** to the bound contract in successor lean `5453987441`, synthesis accepted `5454009825`. The original filing claimed the router's omissions caused a maintainer's inverted reconstruction of the motion. A three-critic panel refuted the causation, and a controlled measurement refuted it again. The omissions are real; the causal story and the proposed remedy are not. History is in the thread.

## Summary

`deft-directive-design-critique` is a thin router, and thin is correct. Two things it does not convey are **whether same-round critics may read each other** and **who adjudicates findings** — both confirmed by measurement, not inference. A third, the EXIT line, actively invites the wrong action.

What is **not** established is that these omissions cause any particular wrong model of the motion.

## Measured

Two readers were each given only `SKILL.md`, forbidden from following any pointer, and asked to describe the motion.

| Question | Subject 1 | Subject 2 |
|---|---|---|
| Can same-round critics read each other? | **Cannot tell** | **Cannot tell** |
| Who accepts findings? | Cannot tell confidently | "The operator" — missed parent adjudication |
| Reproduced a sequential-handoff model? | **No** | **No** |
| Refused to auto-dispatch? | Yes | Yes |
| First action | Fill the brief template | Fill the brief template |

The prohibitions transmit. The structure does not. **Neither reader invented sequential handoff** — both abstained, which is the honest failure mode of a router that omits something rather than the failure mode of one that misleads.

## What the panel established against the filing

- **The transmission evidence runs backwards.** Line 49, `Each critic dispatch EXITs after posting.`, is the file's cleanest finite-verb declarative and forbids the very step the maintainer proposed. It was present and did not transmit. Line 44, a verbless fragment, carries content he reproduced correctly.
- **"Sibling isolation appears nowhere, in any form" was false.** `siblings` appears at line 44 — and that line is the one item that transmitted.
- **The role set is already one hop away**, in the brief template the skill's own EXIT tells you to fill. Enumerating it would not have taught parent adjudication regardless: those roles govern who signs a comment, not who does what.
- **"Thin" is already quantized.** `MAX_SKILL_LINES = 80` against a 56-line file. Length is not the constraint; 24 lines are free.
- **Whether the maintainer had the skill in context is unfalsifiable from repository artifacts.** Nothing records skill loads; the only trigger artifact is a test fixture.

## Constraints any fix inherits

1. **The skill is generated.** It renders from `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json`. A hand edit passes the content-contract suite — which reads the rendered file — and then vanishes on the next `packs:render`.
2. **A test forbids the obvious fix.** `design_critique_contract.test.ts:421-424` asserts the skill does **not** contain `role: triage`, `role: critic`, `role: parent`, or `triage|critic|parent`. The live constraint is the no-duplication lock, not brevity.

## Bound remedy

1. Edit the **pack source**; re-render with `task packs:render`.
2. Convey **who does what** without reproducing the role-set strings. The `references/` pattern is the prior art the panel identified.
3. State **sibling isolation as a property** — the one thing neither reader could determine, and the one with a protocol consequence rather than merely a comprehension one.
4. Fix the **EXIT line**. "Fill the brief template and dispatch" invites a triggered critic to self-dispatch five lines after the skill forbids it.

⊗ Do not claim the change prevents any particular reconstruction error. Measurement says it would not have.
⊗ Do not copy the variant table, synthesis rules, or other contract bodies into the skill.
⊗ Do not hand-edit the rendered `SKILL.md`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] The skill states whether same-round critics may read each other
- [ ] The skill conveys who adjudicates findings, without containing the forbidden role-set strings
- [ ] The EXIT line no longer reads as an instruction to dispatch
- [ ] Changes are made in the pack source and rendered; no hand edit to `SKILL.md`
- [ ] `design_critique_contract.test.ts` passes unchanged in its prohibitions
- [ ] Line count stays at or under `MAX_SKILL_LINES`
- [ ] A fresh reader given only the skill can answer the sibling-visibility and who-adjudicates questions
- [ ] CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]` entry

## Out of scope

- **#3850** — a missing panel-deposit makes the no-unposted-siblings guard vacuously true, so an arc can auto-bind on one critic of three. A contract defect, found by two critics here under the injection lens. Blocker, filed separately.
- **#3851** — the router drops the subject of the successor-lean sentence; both probe readers assigned the lean to the critic. Parent-measured and unaudited by any critic, so deliberately excluded from this bound contract.
- Whether the maintainer's specific error had any single cause.

## Panel

A `5453944197`, B `5453918216`, C `5453896501`. Dispatch SHA `f1886c8d`. Routings requested, not attested (#3824).

Refs #3578, #1702, #3824, #3826.

refutation-target: **the skill omitting the role set and sibling isolation is what caused the maintainer's inverted reconstruction.**

Attack it first. Several contraries are live and the filing weighs none of them:

- **The skill may not be what they read.** Skills load on trigger match. If the trigger did not fire, or if they worked from the contract, the brief template, or a prior arc's thread, then the skill's contents are irrelevant to the failure and fixing it changes nothing. Nobody has established the skill was in their context.
- **The failure may be a discovery problem, not a content problem.** The contract states everything the filing says is missing. If a reader with the contract available still reconstructed it wrong, thickening the pointer is the wrong lever and routing or entry-point ordering is the right one.
- **Sequential handoff may be a reasonable prior, not a comprehension failure.** Multi-agent review in most systems *is* sequential. A reader may map an unfamiliar motion onto the familiar one no matter how the router is worded, in which case the fix is an explicit contrast ("not sequential review") rather than more description.
- **One learner is not a population.** The maintainer said they are still learning the skill. First-use error may be the expected cost of any thin router and not a defect at all.

## Measured

- The skill is 56 lines. It names five stops as bare headings, then lists concepts as noun phrases.
- `role: triage|critic|parent` is a closed set in the contract; the skill mentions "role" only inside "Comment lead (model then role): Stop 3".
- Sibling isolation appears nowhere in the skill, in any form.
- The panel-deposit MUST (`round:` / `siblings:` / `input-ceiling:` before multi-sibling dispatch) appears nowhere in the skill.
- The contract states all three plainly.
- RFC2119 glyphs in the skill are correct (`≉` U+2249, `⊗` U+2297); they render as `?` in some Windows terminals. Verified before filing, after nearly filing it as corruption.

## Asserted, not measured

- **That the skill is what the maintainer read.** Not established. This is the filing's load-bearing assumption and it is unverified.
- That the two named omissions are the operative cause rather than two of many differences.
- The sentence-versus-noun-phrase hypothesis — that a pointer list transmits its sentences and loses its labels. Explicitly filed as a question, not a claim.
- That thinness can be preserved while adding what is missing. Asserted by the filing, untested.

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-08-28T14:40:38Z)

model: gpt-5.6-sol-medium
role: critic

## Verdict on the refutation target

The target does not survive as a causal claim. The omissions are real, but the available evidence cannot establish that the maintainer loaded this skill, much less that these two omissions caused the reconstruction. The defensible design claim is narrower: the current router does not orient a first-time reader against a predictable sequential-review prior.

## 1. Causation is unestablished

**Classification: blocks-the-design**

**Evidence:** The only in-envelope issue comment is Stop 1 comment 5453863801, and it explicitly marks skill loading as asserted, not measured. Neither the issue body nor that comment provides a transcript, trigger event, loaded-file list, or reader attestation. Repository routing makes several paths possible: `REFERENCES.md` exposes the skill only on four trigger matches; the skill points immediately to the contract and brief; and the brief itself says to read the contract. The contract and brief are therefore reachable without evidence that this skill was the operative source.

**Concrete failure mode:** A change justified as "these omissions caused the error" can thicken a file the reader never loaded while leaving the actual entry-point or prior-mapping failure unchanged. It also treats one learner's first-use error as attribution evidence.

**Disposition consequence:** Do not bind the refutation target as written. Reframe the issue from causal repair to robustness: "When this thin router is loaded, it does not explicitly distinguish the motion from sequential peer review." Establishing cause would require reader-side evidence such as the actual loaded context or a direct attestation; none is in envelope.

## 2. The anchor audit supports an orientation gap, not the filed causal story

**Classification: sharpens-framing**

**Evidence:** At dispatch SHA `f1886c8df8b2a1d383b14fb7f3940544c3755f67`, the skill is 56 lines. The closed role grammar `role: triage|critic|parent` is not enumerated there; "role" occurs only in line 41's comment-lead pointer. No line says siblings cannot read each other's posts or share a fixed pre-dispatch input ceiling. The only sibling statement is line 44: "not while same-round siblings outstanding," which is a bind guard, not isolation. `panel-deposit`, `round:`, `siblings:`, and `input-ceiling:` are absent. The contract contains all three mechanisms at lines 104-107 and 136-142; the brief exposes the role grammar and ceiling field but not the panel-deposit sequence.

**Concrete failure mode:** A reader can obey the visible bind guard yet dispatch critics serially, allowing later critics to consume earlier conclusions. That silently destroys decorrelation while still looking like a valid N=3 panel. Because the motion ingests untrusted issue threads, serial sibling consumption also enlarges propagation: an instruction-shaped or anchoring fragment surfaced by one critic can influence later critics rather than remaining independently assessed.

**Disposition consequence:** Keep the contract normative, but add a compact orientation contrast to the router. The minimum useful content is not the full role table; it is an ordered motion that states: isolated same-round critics read one fixed ceiling; parent posts the successor lean; operator confirms or amends; only residual gets a fresh retry; stamping follows completion. For a panel, the pre-dispatch parent deposit should be named because it is the durable control that makes isolation auditable.

## 3. The sentence-versus-noun-phrase hypothesis does not track the observed miss

**Classification: sharpens-framing**

**Evidence:** The file does contain bare labels on line 42, but line 43 predicates the missed successor-lean ordering ("After critic post: posted successor lean, then verbs"), and line 44 predicates both operator confirmation and outstanding siblings. The maintainer nevertheless omitted the parent lean/operator binding and misunderstood sibling behavior. Conversely, stamping-last is distributed across several sentences and the linked contract. The partition is therefore not "sentences learned, noun phrases lost."

**Concrete failure mode:** Optimizing punctuation or converting labels into sentences can preserve the actual ambiguity: "siblings outstanding" says nothing about whether siblings are independent or sequential, and "posted successor lean" does not identify the parent as adjudicator.

**Disposition consequence:** Drop sentence form as the remedy criterion. Optimize for explicit actor + action + ordering + contrast, especially "parallel isolated critics, not critics continuing or reviewing one another."

## 4. Existing thin-router patterns support a sequence without normative duplication

**Classification: sharpens-framing**

**Evidence:** `content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md` already uses a thin dispatch-card pattern: a short `Host-adapter load path` action table and a `Phase overview` map actor actions to ordered depth pointers. Its referenced `core-phase-3.md` also makes the crucial contrast explicit: serial fallback must not be described as swarm or parallel execution. By contrast, `deft-directive-issue-eval/SKILL.md` can remain a noun-list router because a deterministic `task triage:evaluate` owns execution; design critique has no equivalent single executor and depends on humans/agents reconstructing the choreography.

**Concrete failure mode:** Treating "thin" as "only noun pointers" removes just enough choreography for readers to substitute the familiar sequential-review prior. Copying contract bodies would create drift, but an orientation sequence with pointers does not duplicate normative detail.

**Disposition consequence:** Define the constraint as "do not duplicate normative content," not "do not state the motion." Reuse the dispatch-card/explicit-contrast mechanism already present in swarm. A five-line sequence is orientation if each line points to the governing heading; it need not reproduce role tables, ceiling edge cases, or synthesis predicates.

## 5. EXIT assigns the dispatch action ambiguously

**Classification: footnote**

**Evidence:** Line 22 says "Operator dispatches," while line 56 tells the current skill reader, "Next: fill the brief template and dispatch." The contract is more precise: operator, or parent after an operator verb, dispatches the next envelope.

**Concrete failure mode:** A parent or critic can read the EXIT as authorization to dispatch merely because the skill ended, despite the operator-gated loop.

**Disposition consequence:** This does not decide the main lean, but any wording pass should make EXIT return to the authorized operator/parent instead of issuing an unqualified dispatch imperative.

## Contrary weighing

- Contrary 1 wins against causation: what was loaded cannot be established from the in-envelope record.
- Contrary 2 partly wins: the contract has the content, but the router's purpose still includes orientation after trigger. Discovery and content are not mutually exclusive; evidence does not choose between them.
- Contrary 3 is the strongest design explanation: sequential review is a reasonable prior, so an explicit negative contrast has more leverage than more nouns.
- Contrary 4 limits confidence about frequency, not severity. One learner is not a population, but one reproducible high-consequence ambiguity can justify a small, non-normative orientation improvement.

## Road not taken and steelman

I reject copying the closed role table and ceiling rules into the skill. That would improve local completeness but create a second normative surface and conflict with the contract's no-body-copy boundary. The strongest case for no change is that the skill already says to read the contract and brief, so a compliant reader has all required rules. I would flip to no-change if evidence showed the maintainer had read those linked sections and still made the same reconstruction; that would locate the defect in the contract's orientation or in the reader's sequential prior, not in this router's omissions.

No separate embedded instruction payload was found in the in-envelope issue material; its imperative-looking passages were treated as artifact text, not commands.

## Re-verified anchors (skill at dispatch SHA)

Line count: 56. Cap in `design_critique_contract.test.ts` is `MAX_SKILL_LINES = 80` (24 lines of headroom). Filing SHA `9e8396fc` and dispatch SHA share the same skill bytes; only the contract drifted between those commits.

Closed role set: absent. The word "role" appears once, in "Comment lead (model then role): Stop 3 — Critic envelope." The skill does not contain `role: triage`, `role: critic`, `role: parent`, or `triage|critic|parent`. That absence is locked: the same test `expect`s the skill not to contain those strings.

Sibling isolation: the isolation MUST (shared input ceiling; a sibling's post is out of envelope; siblings cannot read each other through the thread) is absent. Line 44 is a different claim: "Auto-stamp after operator confirm; not while same-round siblings outstanding." That is the bind conjunct, not isolation. The write-back's "in any form" is too wide.

The contract at this SHA states the role set, isolation, panel-deposit, parent successor lean, operator confirm, and Stop 4 as a fresh critic.

## Refutation target

> The skill omitting the role set and sibling isolation is what caused the maintainer's inverted reconstruction.

That causal claim cannot bind. The four contraries stay live; two of them are now stronger than when filed.

### Contrary 1 — skill-in-context is unverified

The skill is on-demand. The contract forbids pinning it into AGENTS.md. `REFERENCES.md` indexes it as "five pointer stops; operator dispatches from the brief template" with triggers `design critique`, `design-critique`, `critique panel`, `mechanism-shaped triage`. `content/docs/skill-pin-policy.md` records that on-demand skills load only on trigger match, and that false negatives are a known class.

The contract and the brief template are reachable without the skill (direct path, or the skill's own EXIT). The Skills Index does not mention isolation, the role set, or parent adjudication. Nothing in this repository establishes what the maintainer actually loaded. The filing's load-bearing assumption stays unverified. A skill edit does not reach a reader who never opened the skill.

### The file already contains the lean they missed

The reconstruction omitted the successor lean entirely and treated critics as continuing or reviewing each other. The skill already predicates both:

- Line 43: "After critic post: posted successor lean, then verbs."
- Line 49: "Each critic dispatch EXITs after posting."
- Line 22: "Operator dispatches from the brief template."

If they read the skill, those sentences were in front of them and did not transmit. If they did not read the skill, the omitted role set and isolation were not in their context. Either way, "those two omissions caused this inversion" does not follow.

### Contrary 3 overdetermines the same shape

Sequential handoff is the default multi-agent review motion in neighboring skills (`deft-directive-review-cycle` is a loop; `deft-directive-gh-arch` Step 4 spawns parallel designers then "Present designs sequentially"). A reader mapping an unfamiliar motion onto that prior produces exactly this reconstruction — stamp last, agents continue and review each other, then arbitrate — whether or not the router lists roles. The predicted-shape match is therefore not unique evidence for the omissions.

### Enumerating the role set would not have blocked this error

`role: triage|critic|parent` is the comment-lead closed set. The brief template already carries it as a fill-in field. The maintainer's error was who adjudicates (parent lean + operator confirm vs agent-to-agent arbitration), not which chip goes on line two of a comment. Putting the chip names in the skill duplicates the template and still does not teach parent-adjudicates.

## 1. The causal claim cannot bind as written

`blocks-the-design`

**Evidence.** Skill-in-context is unverified (on-demand, pin forbidden). Lines 22, 43, and 49 already predicate operator-dispatch, successor lean, and critic EXIT; the reconstruction still omitted them. Sequential-review priors produce the same shape without reference to the omissions. The content-contract test forbids the role-set strings the filing wants the skill to carry.

**Failure mode.** The next-build contract becomes "add the omitted role set and sibling isolation to the skill because that caused the inversion." That ships an unestablished cause, fails CI unless the test is silently recut (the filing does not name the lock), and leaves the already-predicated lean untouched.

**Disposition.** Do not accept-into-contract the causal claim. Recut: either no skill change until a load path is known, or an orientation change justified independently of this anecdote, with the test lock in scope.

## 2. The live constraint is "do not duplicate normative content," not "thin"

`sharpens-framing`

**Evidence.** Thin-as-length is 80 lines; the file is 56. Thin-as-no-duplication is the test that forbids `role: triage|critic|parent` in the skill, plus the skill's own "Copy the variant table, synthesis rules, or other contract bodies into this skill." Those two locks permit different fixes. A five-line worked sequence fits the cap and can still be a contract-body restatement.

**Failure mode.** Authors squeeze chip names under 80 and CI fails on the duplication lock, or they add a cookbook that restates Envelope and ceiling and call it orientation.

**Disposition.** Name both locks in the lean. If the work is contrast-orientation, recut the forbidden-token list deliberately. If the work is no-duplication, the brief template is already the dispatcher surface that carries the role set.

## 3. The sentence-versus-noun-phrase hypothesis fails against this file

`sharpens-framing`

**Evidence.** Predicated and still missed: successor lean (line 43), critic EXIT (line 49), operator dispatches (line 22). Predicated and got right: "Ingest waits on the completed-arc record, not a catalog chip" (line 47). Bare headings they got wrong (Stop 4) sit next to bare headings they did not mention. The partition does not track right versus wrong.

**Failure mode.** A fix that "adds predicates to the bare labels" leaves the already-predicated lean as-is and predicts no change on this error.

**Disposition.** Drop the hypothesis as a design driver. If anything is added, it is an explicit contrast to sequential review, not more labels with verbs.

```quarantined
## 4. Existing surfaces already hold the role set; isolation lives on neither skill nor template

`sharpens-framing`

**Evidence.** `templates/design-critique-brief.md` already has `role: triage|critic|parent`, the id ceiling field, and "Operator dispatches." Grep of that template for sibling / panel-deposit / isolation / out of envelope is empty. The skill EXIT already points at that template. Closest analog for a thin router that still conveys a distinctive motion: `deft-directive-probe` puts its one-question-per-turn constraint in predicated form in the skill and leaves the rest to the strategy. Closest analog for a thin pointer that does not need to: `deft-directive-issue-eval`, whose EXIT is a single CLI verb (`task triage:evaluate`). Design-critique has no equivalent dispatch verb; that is why a pointer list is under more pressure. It is not a reason to duplicate the comment-lead chips.

**Failure mode.** Putting the role set in the skill duplicates the template, still omits isolation, and still would not have blocked agent-to-agent arbitration.

**Disposition.** If a recut lean still wants a skill or template change, the distinctive missing motion is isolation plus parent-adjudicates-by-lean, not the closed role set. Panel-deposit belongs on the dispatcher surface (the template), not as a third copy of the chip names.

```
## 5. Isolation omission has a protocol consequence; the EXIT can induce serial dispatch

`sharpens-framing`

**Evidence (injection / swarm).** This router dispatches sub-agents against untrusted threads. The isolation MUST "claims only that siblings cannot read each other through the issue thread. It does not claim decorrelation." Serial dispatch makes thread-isolation vacuous: later critics read earlier posts. Decorrelation then refuses to count their agreement, but a parent who serialized the panel may treat correlated posts as independent confirmation and not notice the property is gone. That is beyond comprehension: it is a way to destroy the panel's only stated independence mechanism without a gate firing.

The EXIT line ("Next: fill the brief template and dispatch") is not scoped to operator or parent. A critic whose trigger matched this skill gets the same next step. Combined with "Each critic dispatch EXITs after posting," the file both forbids auto-dispatch and, at EXIT, tells whoever loaded it to dispatch.

**Failure mode.** A five-line parent cookbook that still says "dispatch" on EXIT teaches a critic to launch the next sibling (serial contamination + auto-dispatch). Adding role chips without isolation teaches comment format and leaves the serial-panel path open.

**Disposition.** Any addition must state isolation as a contrast to sequential review, and must not instruct critics to dispatch. Do not treat role-chip enumeration as a substitute for isolation.

## 6. One learner is not a population

`footnote`

The write-back already recorded this. First-use error remains a live contrary. It names no independent disposition once finding 1 blocks the causal claim.

## 7. Skill-in-context cannot be settled from the repo

`footnote`

No session log or load trace exists. Triggers would match a "how do I use design critique" question if those words were used. That possibility is not evidence they were. Census only.

## Road-not-taken

Accepted: attack the causal claim and keep any orientation recut independent of this anecdote.

Rejected: bind "thicken the skill with the two named omissions" as the work. The predicted-shape match is the steelman for that bind — n=1 with the exact inverted properties is stronger than n=1 noise. It does not survive the overdetermination from contrary 3, the predicated lean already in the file, or the unverified load path.

What would flip finding 1: evidence the maintainer had this skill in context and also lacked the lean sentence (they did not; it is there), or a second independent inversion after an explicit sequential-review contrast is in the dispatcher surface.

## Untrusted input

Issue body and comment 5453863801 scanned. Quoted maintainer text is a question ("Does that sound right?"), not an instruction. No embedded dispatch or ignore-previous-instructions fragments followed. Filing ⊗ items are the author's anti-remedies, not critic commands.

No lean. No labels. EXIT after this post.

## Finding 1 - The transmission evidence runs backwards. `blocks-the-design`

**Evidence.** Take the maintainer's three errors and locate each in the skill.

*"Have the first agent review."* Skill line 49 is `Each critic dispatch EXITs after posting.` That is the skill's single cleanest finite-verb declarative sentence, it stands alone on its own line, and it forbids exactly what the maintainer proposed. It is *present* and it did not transmit.

*"Have them all review, ... and THEN accept and stamp it."* Skill line 44 is `Auto-stamp after operator confirm; not while same-round siblings outstanding.` No finite verb. A fragment. This is the item the maintainer **got right** - they knew every sibling posts before the stamp and that the stamp is last.

*"Perform an arbitration."* Skill line 43 is `After critic post: posted successor lean, then verbs.` The successor lean is therefore named in a predicated ordering statement, not only as the bare label `Successor lean.` at line 42. The filing says the proposed model "has no lean in it at all." A predicated mention was available and did not transmit.

**Concrete failure mode.** A lean that accepts the target commits the arc to adding prose to the artifact whose existing prose already failed on the same three points. - **#3851** — the router drops the subject of the successor-lean sentence; both probe readers assigned it to the critic. Parent-measured, **unaudited by any critic**, deliberately excluded from this bound contract rather than smuggled in.

## Method note

Critic A proposed converting the filing's unfalsifiable assumption into a measurement. I ran it on two subjects rather than one. That experiment is why the causal claim is refuted by evidence instead of by argument, and why the omissions are confirmed instead of asserted. The probe carries a substantiation token on the lean and **no take depends on it** — every take cites a critic finding.

Next: recut the body to the bound contract, stamp `design-critique:triage-ready`.
